name: Click Buffer
description: Buffers early clicks by simulating ahead, and clearly labels the run as assisted.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the click buffer on or off.

window.name: Buffer window (frames)
window.description: How many frames early a click can be and still get buffered (240 Hz physics frames).

lookahead-ms.name: Lookahead budget (ms)
lookahead-ms.description: Max time spent simulating ahead per click. If it runs out, the click is left alone.

block-saving.name: Block saving assisted completions
block-saving.description: Completions that used retimed clicks are not saved.
